 Follow Daniil Medvedev vs Flavio Cobolli live at the 2026 Nitto ATP Finals in Turin: set-by-set score updates, aces and stats on Tennis Channel.
 Coverage by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta Updated November 16, 2026, 3:23 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 3:23 PM ET 3:23 PM ET 2 minutes ago Solid game puts Medvedev up 4-3 on Cobolli (Set 1)
 Dictating baseline exchanges on the hard court at Inalpi Arena , Daniil Medvedev pushes the Set 1 scoreline to 4-3 against Flavio Cobolli . Serving numbers show Medvedev landing 14/17 (82%) of first deliveries compared to 9/11 (82%) for Cobolli .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 Follow VAVEL on Google 3:19 PM ET 6 minutes ago Advantage Medvedev at 3-2 over Cobolli in the opening set
 Daniil Medvedev moves out to a 3-2 lead over Flavio Cobolli in the opening set at the Nitto ATP Finals .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 3:14 PM ET 10 minutes ago Cobolli draws level at 2-2 with Medvedev in the opening set
 Daniil Medvedev and Flavio Cobolli sit level at 2-2 in the opening set at Inalpi Arena . Medvedev has struck 4 aces so far to 2 from Cobolli .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 3:07 PM ET 17 minutes ago Medvedev leads Cobolli 2-1 in Set 1 at Inalpi Arena
 Dictating baseline exchanges on the hard court at Inalpi Arena , Daniil Medvedev pushes the Set 1 scoreline to 2-1 against Flavio Cobolli .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 3:03 PM ET 21 minutes ago Medvedev edges ahead 1-0 over Cobolli in the opening set
 Daniil Medvedev moves out to a 1-0 lead over Flavio Cobolli in the opening set at the Nitto ATP Finals . Serving numbers show Medvedev landing 3/4 (75%) of first deliveries compared to 2/2 (100%) for Cobolli .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 2:59 PM ET 26 minutes ago First serve underway between Medvedev and Cobolli (0-0, Set 1)
 Play is officially underway on the hard court at Inalpi Arena ! Daniil Medvedev and Flavio Cobolli open the first set (0-0) in Group Stage action at the Nitto ATP Finals .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 2:58 PM ET 27 minutes ago Medvedev and Cobolli trade holds to 0-0 in Set 1
 Baseline exchanges continue at Inalpi Arena with Set 1 at 0-0 between Daniil Medvedev and Flavio Cobolli at the Nitto ATP Finals . Total points won stand at 0/0 (0%) to 0/0 (0%) .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 2:30 PM ET an hour ago Stadium 1 schedule update: Medvedev vs Cobolli up next on court
 Play on the main show court at Inalpi Arena runs on a rolling "followed by" schedule at the Nitto ATP Finals : Daniil Medvedev and Flavio Cobolli take the court right after the preceding match concludes.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 2:21 PM ET an hour ago Players standing by at Inalpi Arena: Daniil Medvedev vs Flavio Cobolli next on court
 Daniil Medvedev and Flavio Cobolli are ready in the tunnel area at Inalpi Arena to step onto the hard court for introductions and practice rallies at the Nitto ATP Finals .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 2:13 PM ET an hour ago 15 minutes to scheduled window between Medvedev and Cobolli
 Tournament officials are standing by at Inalpi Arena ahead of player walkouts and the coin toss at the net between Daniil Medvedev and Flavio Cobolli once the show court is clear.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 2:06 PM ET an hour ago 20 minutes to start window: off-court preparation for Medvedev and Cobolli
 Daniil Medvedev and Flavio Cobolli are completing their off-court activation routines at Inalpi Arena ahead of first serve in the Nitto ATP Finals .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 1:59 PM ET an hour ago 30 minutes to scheduled start at Inalpi Arena: Daniil Medvedev vs Flavio Cobolli
 We are 30 minutes away from the scheduled start window at Inalpi Arena (Inalpi Arena) as Daniil Medvedev and Flavio Cobolli prepare for their Nitto ATP Finals clash.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 1:56 PM ET an hour ago Final court check ahead of Medvedev vs Cobolli
 Players are on site at Inalpi Arena as Daniil Medvedev and Flavio Cobolli get ready for action in Nitto ATP Finals .
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 1:38 PM ET 2 hours ago 35 minutes to first serve: Medvedev and Cobolli set for 2:30 p.m. ET walkout
 We are 35 minutes away from Monday night's Ivan Lendl Group clash between No. 4 Daniil Medvedev and No. 5 Flavio Cobolli (not before 2:30 p.m. ET / 20:30 CET) at Inalpi Arena.
 Coin toss and Set 1 game-by-game updates follow shortly on VAVEL USA.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 1:17 PM ET 2 hours ago Evening doubles match nearing completion on Center Court
 Action in the 12:00 p.m. ET (18:00 CET) evening doubles slot is wrapping up inside a packed Inalpi Arena as Italian flags fill the lower bowl ahead of Cobolli's singles entrance.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 12:56 PM ET 2 hours ago Medvedev's seventh trip to the season-ending Top-8 showcase
 Holding a 12-11 career match record at the ATP Finals, 2020 champion and 2021 Turin finalist Daniil Medvedev owns six prior appearances compared to Cobolli's tournament debut tonight.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 12:35 PM ET 3 hours ago Fourth active Italian man to reach the Nitto ATP Finals
 By locking up the No. 5 seed for Turin, 24-year-old Flavio Cobolli joins Jannik Sinner, Matteo Berrettini and Lorenzo Musetti among active Italian singles qualifiers at the year-end championship.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 12:13 PM ET 3 hours ago Hard court vs clay split in the 2-1 head-to-head ledger
 Medvedev won both 2024 outdoor hard-court meetings in straight sets at the US Open (6-3, 6-4, 6-3) and Beijing (6-2, 6-4) before Cobolli captured their lone 2026 clash 6-3, 5-7, 6-4 at the Madrid Masters.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:52 AM ET 4 hours ago 88 combined tour victories between Medvedev and Cobolli in 2026
 Fourth seed Daniil Medvedev enters Turin at 52-20 with four 2026 hard-court titles (Brisbane, Dubai, Hangzhou, Almaty), while fifth seed Flavio Cobolli stands 36-24 highlighted by his Acapulco ATP 500 crown and Roland Garros final run.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago How to watch Daniil Medvedev vs Flavio Cobolli live: US TV channel and stream
 First serve for Daniil Medvedev vs Flavio Cobolli is scheduled for not before 2:30 p.m. ET / 11:30 a.m. PT (19:30 UTC, 20:30 CET) today, Monday, Nov. 16, inside Inalpi Arena in Turin, Italy.
 United States viewers can watch live television coverage on Tennis Channel, with live streaming on the Tennis Channel app and Tennis TV, while Italian fans pack Inalpi Arena alongside a nationwide free-to-air broadcast on Italia 1 and Sky Sport.
 Best-of-three tiebreak sets decide the closing match of Round 1 in the Ivan Lendl Group.
 Follow every game, tiebreak, ace count, first-serve percentage and live Ivan Lendl Group permutation right here on VAVEL USA through match point.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago Evening schedule at Inalpi Arena: doubles curtain-raiser at noon ET
 Monday's evening ticket in Turin begins at 12:00 p.m. ET (18:00 CET) when the No. 2 and No. 7 doubles seeds contest their opening group-stage match on Center Court.
 Yesterday's doubles openers delivered instant drama on this exact court, with top seeds Harri Heliovaara and Henry Patten edging eighth-seeded Brazilians Orlando Luz and Rafael Matos 6-3, 5-7, 10-4 in a Match Tiebreak before fourth seeds Marcelo Arevalo and Mate Pavic defeated Frenchmen Theo Arribage and Albano Olivetti 7-6 (7), 6-4.
 Once tonight's doubles handshakes conclude and the arena crew resets the court lighting, Medvedev and Cobolli walk out not before 2:30 p.m. ET (20:30 CET) to bring down the curtain on Day 2 in northern Italy.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago $15.75 million purse: $405,000 and 200 PIF ATP points on the line tonight
 Every singles match at the Nov. 15-22 Nitto ATP Finals carries massive financial and ranking rewards out of the record $15,750,000 total prize pool.
 Completing all three round-robin matches guarantees $338,000 in participation money, while tonight's winner banks an additional $405,000 check plus 200 PIF ATP Rankings points. Advancing through Saturday's semifinals adds $1,206,000 and 400 points, and lifting Sunday's trophy pays $2,412,000 and 500 points ($5,171,000 total for an undefeated 5-0 champion).
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago 12,000 Italian fans and Medvedev's history playing the pantomime villain in Turin
 For five straight Novembers, Turin spectators packed Inalpi Arena to roar home Jannik Sinner and Lorenzo Musetti; tonight, every chant in Piedmont belongs to 24-year-old Flavio Cobolli.
 Hostile arenas rarely rattle Daniil Medvedev.
 From his famous 2019 US Open run in New York to past Davis Cup and Turin clashes against Italian opposition, the 30-year-old veteran routinely feeds off partisan noise, slowing the tempo between points and leaning on 132-mph flat T-serves to quiet the stands at 30-30.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago Why Medvedev's deep return position collides with Cobolli's inside-out forehand
 Tactically, few matchups in men's tennis offer a clearer geometric contrast on Inalpi Arena's Greenset court.
 Medvedev famously camps five meters behind the baseline on first-serve returns, absorbing 130-mph deliveries and neutralizing pace with dead-flat balls skidding deep down the middle of the court. Against impatient baseliners, that wall extracts dozens of errors into the net tape.
 Cobolli beat that trap in Madrid by mixing heavy kick serves out wide, stepping inside the baseline on ball three to rip 98-mph inside-out forehands and sneaking forward behind disguised drop shots whenever Medvedev retreated against the back tarp.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago Ivan Lendl Group stakes alongside Alcaraz, Tiafoe and Day 1 winners
 Sharing the Ivan Lendl Group with No. 2 seed Carlos Alcaraz and No. 7 seed Frances Tiafoe, both Medvedev and Cobolli know how unforgiving three-match round-robin math becomes after Opening Night.
 Every set won shapes Friday's semifinal tiebreakers.
 Over in Sunday's John McEnroe Group openers, top seed Alexander Zverev dispatched eighth-seeded rookie Rafael Jodar 6-4, 6-4 before third-seeded American Ben Shelton held off sixth-seeded Frenchman Arthur Fils 6-2, 3-6, 6-3. With Alcaraz and Tiafoe opening play in this group earlier today on Center Court, tonight's winner joins the afternoon victor atop the table ahead of Wednesday's 1-0 showdown.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago Head-to-head stands 2-1 Medvedev after Cobolli's three-set Madrid breakthrough
 Medvedev holds a 2-1 advantage in their ATP Tour head-to-head series, yet their lone 2026 encounter went the Italian's way.
 Back in the autumn of 2024 on outdoor hard courts, Medvedev handled a younger Cobolli twice without dropping a set: winning 6-3, 6-4, 6-3 under the lights in the third round of the US Open at Flushing Meadows before repeating 6-2, 6-4 four weeks later in the round of 32 at the China Open in Beijing. Six months ago in the round of 32 at the 2026 Mutua Madrid Open, however, Cobolli refused to blink in a three-set baseline marathon, outlasting Medvedev 6-3, 5-7, 6-4 for his signature spring victory.
 Returning to fast indoor hard court gives Medvedev's flat backhand depth a major say tonight.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago Acapulco champion and Roland Garros finalist: inside Cobolli's climb to No. 5 seed
 Twenty-four-year-old Flavio Cobolli carries the Italian flag alone in the 2026 singles draw, becoming the fourth active Italian man after Jannik Sinner, Matteo Berrettini and Lorenzo Musetti to qualify for Turin.
 Guided from the player box by his father and longtime coach Stefano Cobolli, the Florence-born Roman posted a 36-24 season punctuated by fearless big-stage tennis. In February, Cobolli captured the biggest trophy of his career (and third ATP title overall) on hard courts at the ATP 500 Abierto Mexicano Telcel in Acapulco, defeating fellow Ivan Lendl Group rival Frances Tiafoe in the final. After reaching the clay final in Munich, he authored a sensational fortnight in Paris to reach his maiden Grand Slam singles final at Roland Garros before falling to Zverev, then added a Wimbledon quarterfinal and a Cincinnati Masters 1000 semifinal to peak at World No. 6 in August.
 Remarkably, Cobolli compiled that Top-6 resume while winning 49.5 percent of all individual points played in 2026, thriving on tiebreaks and deciding sets.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago 52 wins and four hard-court trophies: how Medvedev authored a 2026 resurgence
 Daniil Medvedev silenced any talk of a career slowdown by crossing the 50-win threshold for the first time in three years.
 Finishing the regular calendar with a 52-20 tour record, the 6-foot-6 former World No. 1 captured four ATP Tour singles titles exclusively on hard courts across three regions: opening January undefeated in Brisbane, reclaiming the ATP 500 trophy in Dubai, lifting the title in Hangzhou and adding an indoor crown in Almaty this autumn. Along the way, Medvedev knocked out Carlos Alcaraz in the Indian Wells Masters 1000 semifinals in March before finishing runner-up to Jannik Sinner in the desert.
 No active player in the Ivan Lendl Group owns deeper muscle memory at this event.
 Medvedev brings a 12-11 lifetime match record at the Nitto ATP Finals into tonight's clash, highlighted by his unbeaten 5-0 championship run at London's O2 Arena in 2020 and a trip to the inaugural Turin final in November 2021 against Alexander Zverev.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:30 AM ET 4 hours ago Daniil Medvedev faces Italian debutant Flavio Cobolli in Monday night's Turin showcase
 Good afternoon and welcome back to VAVEL USA's live courtside coverage of Daniil Medvedev vs Flavio Cobolli from Inalpi Arena in Turin, Italy. Prime-time singles action in the Ivan Lendl Group at the 2026 Nitto ATP Finals takes Center Court this Monday, Nov. 16, with first serve scheduled for not before 2:30 p.m. ET (11:30 a.m. PT, 19:30 UTC and 20:30 CET local time) live on Tennis Channel.
 Expect a Davis Cup decibel level inside the 12,000-seat Piedmont bowl tonight.
 Fourth-seeded former champion Daniil Medvedev , 30, makes his seventh appearance at the season-ending championship riding a 52-20 campaign and four hard-court titles in 2026. Across the net stands fifth-seeded Italian crowd favorite Flavio Cobolli , 24, celebrating his Nitto ATP Finals debut after surging to a Roland Garros final and a career-high World No. 6 ranking.
 Stay with us for the walkouts, coin toss and live game-by-game score updates.
 Live updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
